lines.t: This is Desert Faith
This is Desert Faith
When you first opened up my eyes
Everything went bright and new
Every promise felt so near at hand
I ran ahead of you
I thought the road would move much faster
That all would fall in place
I didn't know how deeply you refined
What time and truth would shape
This is desert faith
Where belief is formed in time
Not when wonders lead the way
But when I learn to abide
This is desert faith
Through ordinary nights
Learning how to walk with you
When faith is lived, not signed
The path has taught me how to listen
To follow without haste
To stay where you are in every step
And not outrun your pace
You're forming me through faithfulness
We're choosing you each day
The desert teaches how to live
By teaching how to stay
This is desert faith
Where belief is formed in time Not when wonders lead the way
But when I learn to abide This is desert faith
Through ordinary nights Learning how to walk with you
And faith is live not die You've shown me who you truly are
As my roots grow deep in you Even when the desert feels so dry
This is desert faith, rooted deep and slow Not driven by the promise, but faithful where I go
This is desert faith, still learning how to stay Living all you've taught me as you lead me on the way
I will stay with you in the desert
I will walk in all you say
You are forming who I'm becoming
As I learn how to stay
This is desert fate
